title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - FarmHolding
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/FarmHolding. A class to describe a SAREF4AGRI farm holding as a subclass of foaf:Organization (FOAF vocabulary, not modeled here). See the ex:Jansen_and_Sons example in ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.1, Figure 6: the FarmHolding has Farmer members and manages a Farm.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'FarmHolding'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

name.description: Property. foaf:name (standard FOAF property on foaf:Organization, inherited, not re-declared by SAREF4AGRI). The name of the farm holding, e.g. 'Jansen and Sons'.

managesFarm.description: Relationship. s4agri:managesFarm some Farm. The farm(s) this organization manages.

hasMember.description: Relationship. foaf:member (FOAF vocabulary). The farmers who are members of this farm holding.
